Application Data.NAME: Sunrise Shopping Center

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunrise Shopping Center is a well-maintained retail property featuring a diverse mix of tenants, including boutique retail stores, professional offices, and essential service businesses such as a coffee shop and salon. The shopping center emphasizes safety and risk management, equipped with modern security systems and fire suppression measures. Our operations focus on providing quality retail experiences while ensuring minimal liability exposure through effective tenant screening and maintenance practices. We prioritize tenant compliance with safety regulations and actively manage any potential risk factors related to tenant operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/12/2023, a minor water leak occurred due to a malfunctioning HVAC unit in the area occupied by a boutique retail store, resulting in damage to the ceiling and flooring. The estimated repair cost was $2,000, which has been fully settled. The incident was reported to the property management and successfully resolved without further complications. Status: Closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Grade B, UL Listed, Class II Safe with combination lock, fire-rated for 1 hour, capacity of 2500 lbs, located in the center management office.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour security patrols and monitoring, perimeter fencing with gated access, and a comprehensive surveillance camera system throughout the property.
